reviews.comment: Honestly one of most amazing and caring professors I've ever had. My last time taking genetics was super difficult with Reynolds. Dr. Park did his absolute best to make sure we were understanding the material, and truly took his time with us who struggled more. I wish I had a professor like him for other science courses.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: This is a review for BICH431.He will force you to memorize the ins and outs of the material he is teaching. If youre missing a single detail he WILL test on it. If you feel confident on the exams, youll get a B max. There was a grad student taking the class and she failed. Hated the class with a passion, which is a shame bc material the interesting
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This review is for bich 431. The class sucked because the material was boring, with the exception of a few things. It was hundreds of slides with thousands of different concepts that were only tested in the most specific of ways. Also you never know what grade you have in the class because he grades in a 25/25/50 manner. Good luck guessing
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Quizzes and exams are are TRICKY but are heavily curved. Going to lecture and making sure to not slack off are key! Will hint to what types of questions/topics will be on the exams. Has exam review sessions which are SUPER helpful, if you go prepared with questions. Tries to make things easy to remember. Doesn't get off topic in lecture.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Tough grader for what is supposed to be an extremly introdutory course. He seemed to be a little overkill compared to the other profs I heard about. Not terrible, but I will not be taking him for any future classes.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He knows a lot about the subject and could lecture well. The problem was that he often didn't clearly state instructions for assignments, they we're vague or misleading. His point system was out of 100 so every point missed on an assignment/quiz was a point off your final grade. He wouldn't be my first option, but I would take him again.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: There was no homework, study guide, or textbook to use for help. He's clearly knowledgeable in the subject, but maybe to a fault. Material was discussed as if we should already know what it is and class was a review. You have to ask questions to get details. Exams are poorly worded. He curves at his discretion - but you WILL pass if you don't drop.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Park is very good at linking key ideas together as you go throughout the semester. The way he talks about processes and pathways is also very concise as he conveys key ideas very clearly. Beware of exams/quizzes though, the questions are, "mastery based," and they really test your knowledge of the topics.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Let it be clear I spend about 2 hours every day studying for this class, what I found an issue is the way he writes his questions. This class, to me, became more of a "do u know how to read Dr.Parks questions" instead of "Do you know biochem".When u try to argue a question he wont consider ur POV even if the test answer was factually incorrect :/
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Biochem 2 itself is not a hard subject, however, Dr. Park makes it difficult with the way he tests. He is the type to give T/F answers and if you have two trues, you have to choose the best one. It is exhausting to be his student. The only benefit about this class is the cool science behind it.
His exams are "find the magic word" type. Meaning u gotta find the word that's wrong otherwise they will all sound like correct answers and you won't know what to choose.

I'll paint you a picture. You study his slides and your notes for countless hours. You draw the metabolism graph over and over again. You know it all. On the day you get your quiz back you see you barely made above the average, why? Because Dr. Park decided to test you on things that were "implied" instead of what was actually taught in class.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader

reviews.comment: Not a very difficult class but he is a tough grader. There are only 100 points total so a point is deducted from your grade with every point lost on an assignment. One quiz was on subject matter not taught in class (2 quizzes total for 20% of your grade). Group project makes up 40% of your grade and replaces a final exam.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Group projects

reviews.comment: Dr. Park will prepare you for college. He grades strictly and out of few things (that final project :/), but once you get to know him and understand his teaching style Dr. Park is a character and willing to help students succeed, they just have to be the ones putting in the work to reach out to him instead of the other way around. No hand-holding.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Dr. Park would literally tell those of us who bothered to show up for lecture what would be on the exams/quizzes. Just show up to class and get your A. Beware that the the first half of the class is very math heavy and the last half is very conceptual heavy.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Park's lectures were heavy, but if you show up for class you'll easily be able to follow along and understand the material. There were 6 quizzes, 2 tests, and one final and you were allowed a cheat sheet for all of them. In the end, he ended up curving a lot too. He was a great professor and I couldn't recommend him more!
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Park was a stickler about everything. He would hold discussions in class on questions he would ask. The answer he expected was from outside knowledge NOT what is taught. If you put in effort you will be fine, but beware of his nit picky attitude on everything you do.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Park assigned (nearly) weekly homeworks that weren't difficult at all. I'd say it's an average class. It's a pretty easy A: just be in the top half of the class. A group project replaces that of a final. The project at the end of the semester was probably the most annoying thing, but that's the nature of group projects, right?
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: The best professor I've ever had, yet also the hardest. Professor Park teaches in a way that is easy to understand and interesting to listen to - he uses funny and memorable examples in order to get his point across (legos, for example). However his tests require you to really know your stuff as they are very detail oriented.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Amazing lectures--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I took him for GENE 302 as well and had a good experience. His style is to ask tough multiple choice questions, so each question requires you to understand each answer choice, so the tests are pretty comprehensive. You will probably have a bad time in biochem no matter what, but Dr. Park curves more generously and is nice. I also learned a lot.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Park seems to get a bad rep on here, but he was really understanding and fair during the BICH 101 class. There is one group project at the end of the course that was a big chunk of your final grade. There isn't a textbook, but you will have to buy a book and do multiple assignments and discussions about it. Overall, he was a great prof.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Group projects

reviews.comment: As far as getting a good grade, Dr. Park is pretty good. However, he doesn't have a clear teaching format. Each exam is one ppt doc of over 300 slides. Plus your grade is based on ONLY 3 exams. He's nice though, and gives a generous curve.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Class is pretty test heavy as only 3 exams make up your entire grade, but he curves generously. Key to doing well in Park's class is practiciing old exam problems, attending lecture, and asking questions when you feel puzzled.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I really liked Dr. Park. His tests are pretty hard and I originally thought I didn't do too well on them but he very generously curved all of our grades. Only three tests each with equal weight count towards your grade, I highly recommend going to lectures and practicing the old exam problems. The math is sometimes confusing but ask him questions!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: This class is extremely test heavy, but even if you do not do well on one, he gives a relatively generous curve that allows you to come back from it. Problems can be tricky, but if you understand all of the practice exams, you will do well.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: A very straightforward teacher. The class is composed of four exams, all of the same format. Of course there will be days where you have to miss a class, but if you can show up and actively follow the material as he teaches the class will not be too difficult. He answers any questions you ask, any, so ask away.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Initially i did not like the course. His exams are extremely difficult... however, if you go to him and ask for help he is willing to set aside a crazy amount of time to help you pass. He will make sure you pass... He is a very compassionate guy and you will learn a lot from him if you reach out.
reviews.ratingTags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: All in all fair professor. He is very upfront on what you are expected to know for exams and provides many old exams. He really just changes the names and numbers. Tricky problems but easy to memorize math based pattern(gives you cheat sheet for test). Test progressively get harder, but without homework or quizes easy to fall behind.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Don't underestimate the 1st exam - I did and I got a B because of it. I really regret not taking this class seriously until it was too late. It seems very easy, but it'll bite you. Study his notes, do practice problems, and do the practice exams. If he does clicker questions, go to class - you could use the dropped exam. Overall wouldn't take again
He helps in remembering material by tying it to weird stories. Fair on his exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Inspirational--Hilarious--Caring

reviews.comment: I think my biggest complaint is that he is accessible, but not understanding or patient. A friend went to him for a problem and he essentially told her that she may never succeed in her academic endeavors. He also promised a relatively strong curve, but my grade showed no change. Tests concentrated on the MCAT and were visibly harder than others'.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: My biggest problem with his class was his lectures. The power points had multiple errors in them, he might go back and fix later. Those notes were difficult to study since we would sometimes end up with 4 different versions of how to do a problem. Also, his test had errors on them and if you didn't check your test you could easily lose 10  points.
